name: Petra · Wadi Musa
tagline: A rose-red city carved into rock
summary: Stay in Wadi Musa and give Petra two days: the main trail to the Treasury and tombs on day one, the Monastery climb and high viewpoints on day two. Add a night in Wadi Rum's desert.
seasonNote: Summer is very hot in the canyon; winter can be cold, with occasional flash floods.
arrival: About 3 hours by road from Amman or 2 hours from Aqaba; JETT buses run daily.
gettingAround: Petra is explored on foot, around 15 km a day; taxis link hotels to the gate.
cashTip: The Jordan Pass covers the visa and Petra entry if bought before arrival; carry dinars for stalls inside.
foodTip: Try mansaf (lamb with dried yoghurt sauce), maqluba, mezze and sweet knafeh.
buyTip: Sand bottles, Bedouin silver and kohl; don't buy 'ancient' coins or fragments.
baseArea: Near the Petra visitor centre in Wadi Musa

items.name: The Siq and the Treasury
items.summary: A 1.2 km slot canyon that opens onto the carved 40-metre façade of the Treasury.
items.expect: Crowds from 9 am; horse and cart drivers along the way.
items.tip: Enter at 6 am to have the Siq nearly to yourself.

items.name: The Monastery (Ad Deir)
items.summary: Petra's largest monument, reached by about 800 rock-cut steps.
items.expect: A steep 45 to 60 minute climb; donkeys share the path.
items.tip: Climb in the afternoon when the façade is in sun and the steps in shade.
items.priceNote: Planning estimate per adult in local currency, not a live ticket quote; check current prices and what is included.

whyVisit: Petra's largest monument, reached by about 800 rock-cut steps.
It is bigger than the Treasury and far less crowded.
visitFlow: Climb from the basin restaurant area.
Rest at the café opposite, then walk to the viewpoints.
items.bestFor: Visitors interested in history and context and active exploration

items.tip: Go up near the theatre and come down through Wadi Farasa.

items.summary: A protected desert of red sand and sandstone mountains, explored by jeep with a night in a Bedouin camp.
items.expect: Basic camps to luxury domes; cold nights in winter.
items.tip: Book a camp inside the protected area with a jeep tour and dinner included.
